subject: [PATCH nfs-utils 4/5] mountd: don't leak the parent export's fsid onto crossmnt submounts

2026-09-09.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue where cross-mount submounts inherit their parent's file system ID (fsid) instead of generating their own. This causes problems when clients try to access the submount, resulting in ESTALE errors and incorrect file IDs. The patch uses export_attrs_build() to compute the fsid and uuid for each export, ensuring that submounts get their own unique identifiers. It also adds a fallback mechanism to handle cases where an export cannot be resolved.
